safeToReport: On these two targeted whole-project versions, all 14 application criterion verdicts agreed with independent source-based expectations; raw verdicts agreed on 13, with a safe abstention corrected by the server-fail guard.
All 35 exact quotations and UTF-16 source offsets were valid.

publicationGuidance.publicDataSanitization: Use synthetic fixture requirements, source hashes, bounded verdict/explanation summaries and aggregate costs. Do not publish private hosted IDs, authenticated URLs, credentials or raw internal transport metadata.
publicationGuidance.proposedRiskCorrectionNotApplied: Optional visual check: confirm the Services Book a call button placement. The source places it after the consultation section and inside main; no layout defect has been established.

experimentBoundaries: These are two direct real assessDelivery calls against the saved seven-criterion synthetic showcase versions, not app database mutations; the existing hosted saved assessment is unchanged.
The original 19-case baseline, earlier two targeted coverage runs and separate six-case semantic-policy follow-up remain separate experiments and are not overwritten by this result.
This is targeted internal agent adjudication with known fixtures, not a held-out benchmark, an external human study or a general accuracy estimate.
Exact quote validation proves provenance, not semantic entailment. Prompt instructions cannot guarantee that every generated title, explanation or suggested risk follows from the quote.
No browser/runtime behavior, mobile usability, live form backend, exploitable vulnerability, final acceptance, authorization or payment was established by these source-only calls.
mostImportantRemainingRisk: Source-grounded quotations can still support an ungrounded generated title or speculative risk inference. Keep AI suggestions separate from server evidence and buyer acceptance; retain independently reviewable source excerpts and report this failure honestly rather than silently rewriting the raw result.
